site_name: 81 Downhills Park Road, Tottenham, London, N17 6AS
description:
The application relates to the use of the property as C4 - HMO. The application seeks a Certificate of Lawfulness on the basis that the C4 use pre-dated the Article 4 Direction which came into force November 2013. This is evidenced by uninterrupted use of the property as a HMO from the years 2010 to 2020. 
Attached as evidenced of this use in a zip folder are Assured Shorthold Tenancy Agreements, old Sage accounts confirming rental payments for the period, emails to Council Tax, Water Rates and finalised bills. 

The application seeks a Certificate of Lawfulness on the basis that as the HMO use pre-dated the Article 4 Direction, the change of use from C3 to C4 changed lawfully under permitted development rights at that time.

It is sought for the property to be let out on C4 basis.
